newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Colly Cotton to raise A$107 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Colly Cotton to raise A$107 mln.

text.p: Australia's Commonwealth Funds Management said on Monday its cotton producing company Colly Cotton Ltd would make a public offer of 107 million at A$1.00 percent, representing 50 percent of the Colly Cotton shares. The Argentinian based Kahlbetzer group had agreed to buy 25 percent of the remaining 50 percent and Commonwealth FUnds Management would hold the remaining 25 percent.

Colly Cotton forecast a net profit for the year to June 30, 1997 of A$21.4 million, giving earnings per share of 20 cents. It also forecast a full year dividend of 9.7 cents per share to be paid in two instalments in April and October.
The offer would open on September 30, close on October 18 and begin trading on the Australian Stock Exchange on October 30.
Colly Cotton said it had bought up new production areas cheaply during the 1992-95 drought, which was, it said, the worst in over 100 years.

"As a result, we expect our Australian farming, ginning and merchanting activities to achieve a minimum througput of 500,000 bales of cotton in the 1997 season," Colly Cotton Managing Director David Farley said.
